messages.en:
Honey, you're a full-on
fashion disaster! It
takes a lot of work to
look THAT BAD!
messages.et:
Kullake, sa oled täielik
moekatastroof! Nii HALVASTI
väljanägemiseks on vaja
palju tööd teha!

messages.en:
Yeah, honey, I called you
FRUMPY. And believe me,
that's being generous!
messages.et:
Jah, kullake, ma nimetasin
sind LOHAKAKS. Ja usu mind,
see on veel helde!

messages.en:
Redneck...go look that
word up in the dictionary,
honey! You'll see your
name in the definition!
messages.et:
Külajorss... mine vaata see
sõna sõnaraamatust,
kullake! Näed seletuses
oma nime!

messages.en:
Don't EVEN go name-
droppin' Gracie, honey!
You're nothin' but a
fashion wannabe!
messages.et:
Ära ISEGI hakka Gracie
nimega vehkima, kullake!
Sa oled lihtsalt moe-
tahtja!

messages.en:
Blah. Boooooooring. Honey,
you're gonna have to work
it harder than that to
earn my respect.
messages.et:
Pfff. Iiiigav. Kullake,
sa pead palju kõvemini
pingutama, et minu
lugupidamine välja teenida.

messages.en:
For once, you're not
lookin' hideously tacky.
But you're still a long
way from the runway!
messages.et:
Kord ometi ei näe sa
jõledalt labane välja.
Aga podiumini on sul
ikka pikk tee!

messages.en:
Honey, you aren't just
wearing what's hot this
season. YOU'RE what's hot
this season!
messages.et:
Kullake, sa ei kanna
ainult seda, mis on sel
hooajal kuum. SINA OLED
sel hooajal kuum!

messages.en:
You are beyond fabulous!
Gracie has GOT to pay her
respects to the only
true fashionista!
messages.et:
Sa oled üle igasuguse
suurepärasuse! Gracie PEAB
avaldama austust ainsale
tõelisele moeikoonile!
